method: Full pinned source read and Git/SHA256 verification; original AST hit/recursive-angle functions executed with fake nodes/allocation.
findings: Hit testing computes x/distance before checking center layer. Original control at exact center raises ZeroDivisionError, so intended center-reset path is not reached for that coordinate. No live GTK input executed.

Zero-size parent assigns its entire angle to every child. Original control with two zero-size children assigns2pi to each; subsequent Segment normalizes offsets modulo2pi, potentially overlapping them. Pixel rendering remains unverified.
Child angular spans at or below pi/256 are intentionally omitted from chart recursion. Chart visibility therefore cannot demonstrate full-result coverage.
Rendering resets segment list but does not clear selected segment or pending tooltip timeout. Old selection may survive model/root changes; actual event-loop effect remains untested.
find_root and recursive_angle recurse by tree depth without local depth budget. Scanner depth configuration and Python recursion behavior are separate qualification gates.
Tooltip text is escaped before truncation to60 characters, allowing truncation inside markup entities. No Pango parse failure claimed without runtime control.
Drawing calculations divide by minimum allocation dimension and tooltip geometry uses tangent division. Zero/small allocation behavior requires actual Cairo/GTK validation.
Charts aggregate logical node sizes and do not prove physically reclaimable storage, duplicate partition completeness or scan success.

executed_control.scope: Original extracted hit/angle methods with fake nodes and allocation; no Cairo drawing or GTK event loop.

limits: No chart screenshots, actual GUI events or performance qualification.
